notes: Edition-locked widget pools: each edition's Control Center picker only shows widgets in its own pool (Main + Zen share general widgets; Dev gets dev-only utilities; Student gets student-only academic tools; Pomodoro and Todo stay cross-edition since they're universal). Defaults updated so Dev no longer references the Main 'status' widget and Student no longer references the Main 'visualizer' widget. Saved layouts that point at a now-disallowed widget gracefully fall back to the edition's default for that slot.
